title: HNSCC ID-3 Translational therapy monitoring of locally advanced or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) with 18F-FDG PET-CT and liquid biopsy under immunotherapy
summary: In this study multimodality evaluation of first-line immunotherapy in locally advanced and metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma by 18F-FDG PET/CT and liquid biopsy will be examined. Primary aim of this study is the validation of quantitativ biomarkers in early response assessment.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of base of tongue
Malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified parts of tongue
Malignant neoplasm of floor of mouth
Malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified parts of mouth
Malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified major salivary glands
Malignant neoplasm of other and ill-defined sites in the lip, oral cavity and pharynx
Malignant neoplasm of nasal cavity and middle ear

interventions.name: Patients with HNSCC will be examined at three time points of response assessment - at baseline, 8-12 weeks later, 6 months later - with 18F-FDG PET/CT and liquid biopsy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- First-line immunotherapy
- locally advanced / metastatic disease
- target lesions in PET/CT
- life expectancy > 6 months
Exclusion criteria:
- autoimmune disease
- local resection or treatment of HNSCC
- treatment with steroids or immunosuppressive medication
